 AHMEDABAD MUNICIPAL CORPORATION  Versus  CHANDARBHAI DINESHBHAI MAHESHWARI ==========================================================
Appearance:
MS JIRGA D JHAVERI(3471) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR MANISH R RAVAL(1250) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR L R PUJARI APP(2) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE G.R.UDHWANI  Date : 23/04/2018 Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation vs Chandarbhai Dineshbhai Maheshwari on 23 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144996323/
1  ORAL JUDGMENT Judgment and order dated 17/09/2011 recording acquittal for the respondent No.1 for the  offence punishable under Section 7 read with Section 16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration  Act, 1954 by R/CR.A/1631/2012 JUDGMENT the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Court  N o . 6 , A h m e d a b a d i n C r i m i n a l C a s e N o .
1 3 8 7 o f 2 0 0 9 i s  assailed in this appeal under Section 378(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure Code.
2. The respondent No.1 was charged with adulteration of the pepper black.

It is not necessary  to delve upon the detailed facts in the light of the argument by the learned Counsel for the  a p p e l l a n t t h a t i m p u g n e d j u d g m e n t a n d o r d e r s u f f e r s f r o m n o n  application of mind; inasmuch as, paragraph No.17 of the impugned judgment and order is  d e v o t e d t o t h e a d u l t e r a t i o n o f c o t t o n s e e d o i l a n d a l l t h e r e a s o n s  applicable to cotton seed oil have been assigned to find breach of Rule 4(4) of the PFA Rules.
3.

While the learned Counsel for the appellant would submit that the said findings suffer from non application of mind, learned Counsel for respondent No.1 would contend that it was  only because of the typographical error as indicated in Ex.50 by the trial Court that for  pepper black, the words 'Kapasiya no Tel' (cotton seed oil) have been used.
True it is, that the Court at Exh.50 has pointed out that since on the relevant date, there  were three cases fixed, one amongst whom pertained to cotton seed oil, that the error  has crept in.
The fact, however, remains that the reasonings in paragraph No.17 may  or may not be good for pepper black.
It does not seem to be a mere case of  typographical error; but whole paragraph No.17 deals with cotton R/CR.A/1631/2012 J U D G M E N T s e e d o i l ; i n s t e a d o f p e p p e r b l a c k .
T h e t r i a l C o u r t  is thus required to apply its mind again qua pepper black.
4 . F o r t h e f o r e g o i n g r e a s o n s , t h e i m p u g n e d
judgment and order cannot be sustained.
Accordingly, the same is quashed and set aside.
T h e c a s e i s r e m a n d e d t o t h e C o u r t o f l e a r n e d M e t r o p o l i t a n  M a g i s t r a t e , A h m e d a b a d f o r d e c i d i n g a f r e s h o n l y t o t h e
e x t e n t i n d i c a t e d a b o v e . I t w o u l d b e o p e n f o r b o t h t h e

sides to raise all contentions so far as the pepper black is concerned in the context of the reasonings  given by the Court below in paragraph No.17. 
(G.R.UDHWANI, J) SOMPURA Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation vs Chandarbhai Dineshbhai Maheshwari on 23 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144996323/
